limitation: Android emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64, API 36), not a physical handset. No device was attached to adb; this is the closest executable substitute and is labelled as such.

checks.name: install_replaces_older_build
checks.evidence: The emulator had 2.0 (versionCode 2, ALLOW_BACKUP) signed with another key. Uninstalling then installing this build reports versionName=2.5, versionCode=7.

checks.name: backup_disabled
checks.evidence: dumpsys package flags for the old build: [HAS_CODE ALLOW_CLEAR_USER_DATA ALLOW_BACKUP]; for this build: [HAS_CODE ALLOW_CLEAR_USER_DATA].

checks.name: uninstall_leaves_nothing
checks.evidence: After pm uninstall: pm path empty, dumpsys package reports 'Unable to find package', /sdcard/Android/data/com.luhui.phoneproxy does not exist.

checks.name: notification_denied_app_still_works
checks.evidence: Denied POST_NOTIFICATIONS (granted=false), app renders and remains usable; a repeated request on every cold start was found and fixed (notif_asked flag).

checks.name: empty_pool_is_explained_and_does_not_crash
checks.evidence: Public build ships zero nodes; the screen says 节点池为空 and logcat shows no crash when 启动代理 is tapped.

checks.name: private_subscription_url_rejected_at_runtime
checks.evidence: Importing http://127.0.0.1:8080/nodes.txt shows 导入失败：订阅地址不可用：host_private (evidence/proxy-uri-ssrf-rejected2.png).

checks.name: public_subscription_url_reaches_the_network
checks.evidence: Importing https://example.com/subs.txt shows 导入失败：HTTP 404, i.e. the guard allowed the host and the request returned a status (evidence/proxy-uri-public-result.png).

checks.name: background_ui_updates_fixed
checks.evidence: The first emulator run showed 导入失败：Only the original thread that created a view hierarchy can touch its views. appendLog/toast now hop to the main thread; the same import then showed the real reason.

not_verified: A physical handset (none attached to adb).
Real VPN tunnel traffic: the public build has no nodes and the test device has no account; the VPN service path is exercised only through its start/stop state machine.
